source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

chapter_binding.source_omission_reason: Absent from pinned SBLGNT; the parent Fluent already preserves this numbering gap.
chapter_binding.tsw_omission_reason: TSW also lacks these public labels; comparator bytes unchanged.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains inevitability, harm, and personal responsibility.
key_decisions.before: Jesus said to his disciples, “It is impossible for causes of stumbling not to come, but woe to the person through whom they come!
key_decisions.after: Jesus said to his disciples, “Stumbling blocks are certain to come, but woe to the person through whom they come!
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And he said to his disciples, “It is impossible for stumbling blocks not to come, but woe to the one through whom they come!

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves violent warning, millstone, sea, and protection of one little one.
key_decisions.before: It would be better for that person if a millstone were hung around the neck and they were thrown into the sea than for them to cause one of these little ones to stumble.
key_decisions.after: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck and he were thrown into the sea than for him to cause one of these little ones to stumble.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck and he were cast into the sea than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps self-watch, confrontation, repentance, and forgiveness.
key_decisions.before: Watch yourselves. If your brother or sister sins, rebuke them; and if they repent, forgive them.
key_decisions.after: Watch yourselves. If your brother sins, rebuke him; and if he repents, forgive him.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Take heed to yourselves. If your brother sins, rebuke him, and if he repents, forgive him.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains exact repetition, personal offense, return, and command.
key_decisions.before: Even if they sin against you seven times in a day and seven times return to you saying, ‘I repent,’ you must forgive them.”
key_decisions.after: Even if he sins against you seven times in a day and returns to you seven times saying, ‘I repent,’ you must forgive him.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And if he sins against you seven times in the day and seven times returns to you, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps small-seed comparison, mulberry tree, impossible command, and obedience.
key_decisions.before: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a mustard seed, you would say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.
key_decisions.after: The Lord replied, “If you had faith like a mustard seed, you could say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And the Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves humble status and duty without implying worthlessness as persons.
key_decisions.before: So you also, when you have done everything commanded of you, say, ‘We are servants without a claim; we have done what we ought to have done.’”
key_decisions.after: So you also, when you have done everything you were ordered to do, should say, ‘We are servants who deserve no special credit; we have only done what we were obligated to do.’”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So you also, when you have done all that was commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants; we have done what we ought to have done.’”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps journey destination and difficult between-regions geography.
key_decisions.before: As Jesus was going to Jerusalem, he traveled along the border between Samaria and Galilee.
key_decisions.after: On the way to Jerusalem, Jesus was passing along the border between Samaria and Galilee.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And it happened as he was going to Jerusalem that he was passing between Samaria and Galilee.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains exact number, men, condition, meeting, and distance.
key_decisions.before: As he entered a village, ten men with skin diseases met him. They stood at a distance
key_decisions.after: As he entered a village, ten men with a skin disease met him. They stood at a distance
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And as he was entering a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves seeing, priestly inspection, obedient movement, and cleansing en route.
key_decisions.before: When he saw them, he said, “Go show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.
key_decisions.after: When he saw them, he said, “Go show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And seeing them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” And it happened as they were going, they were cleansed.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves posture, gratitude, and climactic identity.
key_decisions.before: He fell facedown at Jesus’ feet and thanked him. And he was a Samaritan.
key_decisions.after: He fell facedown at Jesus’ feet and thanked him. He was a Samaritan.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and fell on his face at his feet, giving thanks to him. And he was a Samaritan.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains outsider label, return, and divine glory.
key_decisions.before: Was no one found to return and give glory to God except this foreigner?”
key_decisions.after: Was no one found to return and give glory to God except this foreigner?”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Was no one found returning to give glory to God except this foreigner?”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps bodily command and broad save/heal language.
key_decisions.before: He said to the man, “Get up and go. Your faith has saved you.”
key_decisions.after: Then he said to the man, “Get up and go. Your faith has saved you.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And he said to him, “Rise and go; your faith has saved you.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves question, coming, and non-observable manner.
key_decisions.before: The Pharisees asked Jesus when God’s kingdom was coming. He answered, “God’s kingdom does not come with observable signs,
key_decisions.after: When the Pharisees asked when the kingdom of God was coming, Jesus answered, “The kingdom of God does not come in a way that can be closely observed.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And being asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God is coming, he answered them and said, “The kingdom of God is not coming with observable signs,

key_decisions.rationale: Renders entos as among this hostile plural audience while retaining deictic contrast.
key_decisions.before: nor will people say, ‘Look, here it is!’ or, ‘There!’ For look—God’s kingdom is in your midst.”
key_decisions.after: People will not say, ‘Look, here it is!’ or ‘There it is!’ For look, the kingdom of God is among you.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: nor will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘There!’ For behold, the kingdom of God is in your midst.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps visible lightning analogy and variant-marked “his day.”
key_decisions.before: Just as lightning flashes and lights the sky from one side to the other, so the Son of Man will be in his day.
key_decisions.after: For just as lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other, so will the Son of Man be in his day.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For as the lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one side to the other, so will the Son of Man be in his day.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains priority, necessity, suffering, and generational rejection.
key_decisions.before: But first he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
key_decisions.after: But first he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But first he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves ordinary activities, Noah, ark, sudden flood, and total destruction.
key_decisions.before: People were eating, drinking, marrying, and being given in marriage until the day Noah entered the ark. Then the flood came and destroyed them all.
key_decisions.after: People were eating, drinking, marrying, and being given in marriage until the day Noah entered the ark. Then the flood came and destroyed them all.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: they were eating, drinking, marrying, being given in marriage, until the day Noah entered the ark, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains Sodom, exact timing, fire, sulfur, heaven, and destruction.
key_decisions.before: But on the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained from heaven and destroyed them all.
key_decisions.after: But on the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained from heaven and destroyed them all.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: but on the day Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from heaven and destroyed them all.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves locations, possessions, urgency, and two prohibitions.
key_decisions.before: On that day, anyone on the housetop whose possessions are in the house must not go down to get them, and anyone in the field must not turn back.
key_decisions.after: On that day, anyone on the housetop whose belongings are inside the house must not go down to get them. Likewise, anyone in the field must not turn back.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: On that day, the one who is on the housetop, and his goods in the house, must not go down to take them away; and likewise the one in the field must not turn back.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps stark memorial warning.
key_decisions.before: Remember Lot’s wife.
key_decisions.after: Remember Lot’s wife.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Remember Lot’s wife.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains save/lose paradox and singular referent.
key_decisions.before: Whoever seeks to preserve their life will lose it, but whoever loses it will keep it alive.
key_decisions.after: Whoever seeks to preserve his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life will keep it alive.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Whoever seeks to preserve his life will lose it, but whoever loses it will keep it alive.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps night, one bed, pair, and unresolved taken/left contrast.
key_decisions.before: I tell you, that night two will be in one bed; one will be taken and the other left.
key_decisions.after: I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed; one will be taken and the other left.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I tell you, in that night there will be two in one bed; one will be taken and the other left.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains female workers and repeated contrast.
key_decisions.before: Two women will be grinding together; one will be taken and the other left.”
key_decisions.after: Two women will be grinding grain together; one will be taken and the other left.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: There will be two grinding together; one will be taken and the other left.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves absent public verse 36, question, corpse/body, and ominous birds.
key_decisions.before: They asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said, “Where the body is, there the vultures will gather.”
key_decisions.after: The disciples asked him, “Where, Lord?” He replied, “Where the body is, there the vultures will gather.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And answering, they say to him, “Where, Lord?” And he said to them, “Where the body is, there also the vultures will be gathered.”
